Playbook.name: Windows — Defender / EDR / Firewall Tampering - SOC Playbook

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: A command line disabling Defender/EDR/firewall ran - Set-MpPreference disabling real-time protection, netsh advfirewall off, stopping AV/EDR services, or adding exclusions. Triage question: is an attacker blinding defenses, or an admin/tool making an authorised change?
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: Disabling endpoint defenses precedes payload execution; catching it early can pre-empt the main attack.

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: Windows Security + Sysmon + PowerShell logs via Elastic Agent (verified live). Sysmon event.code 1=process(command_line/parent populated), 11=file, 13/12=registry(registry.path populated); process.code_signature NOT collected.

Signal.Name: Defense tampering
Signal.Details: Set-MpPreference disable, firewall off, AV/EDR service stop, exclusion add.

InitialAssessment.Rule: Weigh the evidence story, not any single fact - see ClassificationGuidance.

Investigation.Goal: Determine whether the defense-tampering command is an attacker blinding controls or an authorised administrative change.

Step.name: Confirm the tampering command
Step.Purpose: The command shows what was disabled (RTP, firewall, service) or excluded.
Step.Query: FROM logs-windows.sysmon_operational-*,logs-system.security-* | WHERE event.code IN ("1","4688") AND host.name == "$hostname" AND process.command_line IS NOT NULL AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | EVAL cl = TO_LOWER(process.command_line) | WHERE cl LIKE "*set-mppreference*" OR cl LIKE "*disablerealtimemonitoring*" OR (cl LIKE "*netsh*" AND cl LIKE "*firewall*" AND cl LIKE "*off*") OR (cl LIKE "*sc *" AND cl LIKE "*stop*" AND (cl LIKE "*sense*" OR cl LIKE "*windefend*")) OR cl LIKE "*add-mppreference*exclusion*" | KEEP @timestamp, process.name, process.parent.name, user.name, process.command_line | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 20
Step.AnalystNotes: DisableRealtimeMonitoring $true or an exclusion path pointing at a payload dir = attacker blinding. netsh firewall off + AV stop together is a strong pre-attack signal. An admin adding a legitimate exclusion under change control is benign.

Step.name: Process origin and account on the host
Step.Purpose: The parent process and account reveal whether this was interactive attacker activity or an automated/service context.
Step.Query: FROM logs-windows.sysmon_operational-*,logs-system.security-* | WHERE event.code IN ("1","4688") AND host.name == "$hostname" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 2 hours | STATS runs = COUNT(*), parents = VALUES(process.parent.name), users = VALUES(user.name) BY process.name | SORT runs DESC | LIMIT 15
Step.AnalystNotes: A suspicious process spawned by an office app/browser/script interpreter, run by a normal user, is more concerning than one under a known admin/automation parent.

Node.Condition: Real-time protection disabled or an exclusion added for a suspicious path, especially by a non-admin or before other execution.
Node.Result: True Positive (Defense Evasion - IR, re-enable protection)

Node.Condition: A documented admin change (e.g. approved exclusion for a business app) under a ticket.

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-TAMPER-CMD, INV-02-PROC-TREE to the case.

FalsePositive.Definition: An authorised administrative change (approved exclusion, maintenance).

SOCAction.Item: Verify the change; close as false_positive.

Indicators.Item: RTP disabled / firewall off / EDR stopped.

SOCAction.Item: Re-enable protection immediately; isolate the host; open IR.
Hunt for what ran while defenses were down.

Misconfiguration.Definition: A software installer disabling AV temporarily by design.

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: Confirm the activity on the host; if malicious indicators, isolate the host.
Identify the responsible account/process and its origin.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Isolate the host; capture volatile evidence; hunt the same pattern across the estate.
Reset credentials used on the host if compromise is confirmed.

Phase.name: Recovery and Hardening (days)
Phase.Action: Remediate the root cause; add/verify EDR coverage; apply relevant hardening.

QualityChecks.Check: Confirm the required telemetry (Sysmon/Security auditing) is present on the host.
Tune known-benign administrative sources via exceptions, not by disabling the rule.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: Host contained and triaged; root cause eradicated; estate swept; findings recorded.
